current_events: At least 21 people are injured after a car bomb explodes next to the Meta Department Government building in downtown Villavicencio
Three civilians are injured and 60 homes are damaged following a drone attack against a police station in Cúcuta. This is the first registered drone attack in an urban area in Colombia
Colombian conflict, Terrorism in Colombia
Ukraine launches a large-scale drone attack across western Russia, striking the Perm refinery in Perm Krai and Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov Oblast
Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war
Turkish intelligence reports that the Kurdistan Workers' Party withdraws from 14 additional bases in northern Iraq as part of an ongoing disarmament process aimed at ending its conflict with Turkey

At least 30 people are injured, eight seriously, and 12 shops are vandalised as rival factions of the banned Awami League clash in two separate incidents and detonate four crude bombs in Gopalganj District, Bangladesh
At least 15 people are injured and 28 houses and shops are vandalised during clashes between rival Bangladesh Nationalist Party factions in Shailkupa Upazila, Jhenaidah District, Bangladesh
Aftermath of the July Uprising

Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer less than two weeks after he resigned following revelations of an affair with Alice Huang, who is suspected by U.S. intelligence of spying for China
Jensen Huang scandal, Chinese intelligence activity abroad
Seven people are killed and two others are injured after a truck loaded with stones overturns onto a minitruck in Punjab, Pakistan
A 58-year-old student dies at Sapienza University in Rome, Italy, while being on a hunger strike protesting the fact that he had not been assigned a place to stay
British foreign secretary Ed Miliband announces sanctions against five military leaders of Myanmar, while also granting recognition of the Rohingya genocide
Myanmar–United Kingdom relations, Rohingya genocide case
Tajikistan formally begins the process of withdrawing from the International Criminal Court

The Supreme Court of Spain grants amnesty to former Catalan president Carles Puigdemont, who is currently in self-imposed exile in Belgium, thereby bringing the legal proceedings against the leaders of the October 2017 declaration of independence to a definitive close
2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis
Hundreds of schools across Denmark and Germany receive bomb threats via email, with police ordering the schools to continue operations as normal
2026 European bomb threat wave
Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi receives 74 lashes for performing at a music concert without a hijab

The Superior Court of Quebec suspends a 2022 law making allegiance to Canada's monarch optional for provincial legislators, requiring them to swear an oath to King Charles III before sitting in the National Assembly

In association football, FIFA confirms Costa Rica, Jamaica, Mexico, and the United States as joint hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup, while England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales will jointly host the 2035 tournament
